ASICS Men's GEL-NIMBUS 28

Style: 1011C127 | Color: BLACK/GRAPHITE GREY

The ASICS GEL-NIMBUS 28 delivers premium cushioning and smooth transitions for neutral runners. Enhanced with PureGEL™ technology and FF BLAST™ PLUS ECO cushioning, this shoe provides cloud-like comfort mile after mile. The engineered knit upper adapts to your foot's natural motion while maintaining breathability, making it ideal for daily training and long-distance comfort. With improved heel geometry and a softer midsole foam, the NIMBUS 28 offers an even more luxurious ride than ever before.

Key Features:

  • PureGEL™ technology for lightweight cushioning and shock absorption
  • FF BLAST™ PLUS ECO cushioning for soft landings and energetic toe-offs
  • Engineered knit upper for breathability and adaptive fit
  • OrthoLite™ X-55 sockliner for premium step-in comfort
  • AHAR™ Plus outsole rubber for exceptional durability
  • Reflective details for low-light visibility

Technology Highlights:

The GEL-NIMBUS 28 represents decades of ASICS innovation in neutral cushioned running shoes. The combination of PureGEL™ technology and FF BLAST™ PLUS ECO cushioning creates a softer, more responsive ride that feels plush without sacrificing energy return. The engineered knit upper wraps your foot in breathable comfort while providing adaptive support throughout your run.

Best For: Daily training runs, long-distance running, neutral runners seeking premium cushioning and comfort

HOKA Speedgoat 7

Named after legendary ultrarunner Karl "Speedgoat" Metzler, the Speedgoat 7 continues its legacy as the ultimate trail shoe for technical terrain. With enhanced traction, improved durability, and signature HOKA cushioning, this trail icon is ready for your toughest adventures.

Key Features:

  • Vibram® Megagrip Outsole: World-class traction compound grips wet and dry surfaces with confidence
  • 5mm Lugs: Deep, multi-directional lugs provide aggressive grip on technical trails
  • Enhanced Upper: Reinforced construction offers improved durability and protection
  • Responsive Cushioning: Generous midsole foam absorbs impact while maintaining trail feel
  • Protective Toe Cap: Guards against rocks and roots on technical terrain
  • Gusseted Tongue: Keeps debris out during challenging trail conditions

Technical Specifications:

  • Stack Height: 33mm heel / 29mm forefoot
  • Heel-to-Toe Drop: 4mm
  • Weight: 9.7 oz (men's size 9) / 8.1 oz (women's size 7)
  • Support Type: Neutral
  • Cushioning Level: Moderate-High
  • Terrain: Technical trails, mountain running, ultra-distance

Best For:

  • Technical trail running on rocky, rooty, and uneven terrain
  • Ultra-distance trail races and training
  • Mountain running and vertical challenges
  • Wet and muddy trail conditions
  • Multi-day trail adventures

Who Should Run in This Shoe:

  • Trail runners tackling technical terrain
  • Ultra-distance athletes requiring durability and protection
  • Mountain runners navigating steep, rocky trails
  • Runners seeking aggressive traction without sacrificing cushioning
  • Adventure runners exploring varied and challenging terrain

The HOKA Speedgoat 7 is built for trail runners who demand the best. Whether you're racing 100 miles through the mountains or exploring technical singletrack, the Speedgoat 7 delivers unmatched traction, protection, and cushioned comfort when you need it most.
